description: SEARCH(data, query [, ANALYZER => ...] [, SEARCH_MODE => 'OR'|'AND']) - token-based full-text search: whole-TOKEN matching rather than substring (so 'kingdom' does not match 'king'), case-insensitive, OR semantics by default and AND requiring every query token, with a tuple first argument searching across several columns at once and matching in either. Snowflake ships exactly three analyzers - live-verified, ANALYZER => 'PATTERN_ANALYZER' or any other name fails "Object 'PATTERN_ANALYZER' does not exist or not authorized." while UNICODE_ANALYZER, NO_OP_ANALYZER and DEFAULT_ANALYZER resolve. A NULL data or query yields NULL. Converted 1:1 from functions/SearchTest (now retired); its @BeforeEach lines fixture is inlined per test.

steps.sql: SELECT SEARCH('the king is dead', 'king queen')
SELECT SEARCH('the king and queen', 'king queen', SEARCH_MODE => 'AND')
SELECT SEARCH('the king is dead', 'king queen', SEARCH_MODE => 'AND')
SELECT SEARCH('the king', 'king queen', SEARCH_MODE => 'AND', ANALYZER => 'DEFAULT_ANALYZER')
CREATE TABLE lines (play VARCHAR, line VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO lines VALUES ('Hamlet', 'To sleep, perchance to dream'), ('Macbeth', 'The king is dead')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lines WHERE SEARCH((play, line), 'dream')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lines WHERE SEARCH((play, line), 'macbeth')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lines WHERE SEARCH((play, line), 'queen')
